AUSPACK 2021: Advancing Packaging and Processing Solutions in the Asia-Pacific
#

AUSPACK stands as Australia’s premier international exhibition for packaging and processing machinery, materials, and associated technology. As the leading event in the southern hemisphere for the processing and packaging industry, AUSPACK consistently brings together a diverse range of suppliers, exhibitors, and industry professionals from across the globe.
